observed_defects.severity: cosmetic, client-visible, does not affect permission state
observed_defects.title: The Crew > Players 'Navigator:' caption does not follow a live grant or revoke, and once wrong it stays wrong
observed_defects.state_is_correct: vessel_stat 11, the role varbit, ToriRSServer_VesselCanNavigate and ToriRSServer_VesselCargoAllowed all track the grant and the revoke exactly; the captain's chat carries the content's own grant/remove lines. Only the caption is wrong. The acceptance rows measure the state, so they pass, and they are right to pass.
measured: GRANT with the panel open: after the armed mouse click and 90 stepped frames (3 server ticks) the caption still read 'Navigator: finalcap' while navigator_mask was 2, role 6 and VesselCanNavigate true. Repeated with 'peer target' and 300 stepped frames (10 ticks): still 'finalcap'.
Re-entering the panel republishes correctly: 'cheat sailpanel' off, on, then the Crew/Players clicks, and the caption reads 'Navigator: Deckhand' with mask 2.
REVOKE with the panel open: mask 2 -> 0, VesselCanNavigate false, and after 1020 further stepped frames (34 ticks) the caption still read 'Navigator: Deckhand'.
Running the publisher by hand in the captain's own context - harness 'proc sailing_player_names' - did NOT republish either: the caption stayed 'Deckhand' at mask 0.
observed_defects.mechanism: OSRS-Content/osrs239-content/server/scripts/sailing/scripts/boat_social.rs2, [proc,sailing_player_names]. The memo guard is on line 6 of the proc ('if (%sailing_social_names_serial = $serial & %sailing_social_names_mask = $mask) return;') and the memo is WRITTEN on lines 7-8, twenty lines AHEAD of the side effect it guards, 'runclientscript*(8777)(1, 1, $captain_name, $navigator_names)' on line 26. Between the write and the publish the proc re-points the active player four times (p_finduid($captain), p_finduid($who) in the name loop, p_finduid($viewer)) and has an early return at line 25. The direct 'proc sailing_player_names' probe returning without publishing, at a (serial, mask) the client demonstrably has not been told about, proves the memo had already been marked spent for that exact state by an earlier pass whose publish never reached this viewer. A memo must be written AFTER the publish it stands for, or a pass that does not publish permanently suppresses every later pass until the serial or mask changes again.
observed_defects.not_owned_by_this_worker: boat_social.rs2 is content and belongs to the lifecycle/social content owner (Copernicus's list). No fix was attempted here and no source was edited. Reported for root to assign.
observed_defects.why_it_survived_until_now: Every prior capture of this caption was taken just after a panel open, which is the one path that publishes.

not_proven_here: Two external socket transports. The guest is a real second server player driven through the harness's peer verbs, which is what the rows say.
